description: Quantity -> productivity -> duration rate library. Pilot scope: ONE activity type (suspended_ceiling). Rates are per worker per 8h construction day. Edit rates here only (single source); never hard-code in Python.

suspended_ceiling.label_zh: 天花吊顶 (龙骨 + 封板/矿棉板)
suspended_ceiling.rate_basis: Office fit-out, 2.7-3.0m ceiling, exposed-grid mineral fibre or gypsum lay-in incl. hangers/main tees/cross tees and board fixing. Industry rule-of-thumb 8-15 m2/worker-day; pilot uses 10 until field-calibrated.

legacy_template_bridge.note: Legacy WBS tasks carry no quantity. When --productivity_pilot is on, tasks whose name contains a match keyword are tagged suspended_ceiling and quantity = gross area x ratio (net ceiling area). Derived quantity downgrades confidence. When the Quantity Engine (core/quantity_engine.py, config/quantity_benchmarks.json) supplies derived quantities, the entry's quantity_key (ceiling_area) is used instead of this ratio; the ratio stays as the fallback when no engine output is passed.
